title: OCR Benchmarking and Merchant Onboarding Automation
problem: Manual verification of ID and bank documents during high-volume merchant onboarding was slow and inconsistent, with highly variable document quality limiting OCR accuracy.
actions: Benchmarked OCR vendors (Google, AWS, Azure) on extraction accuracy across ID and bank documents
Applied image preprocessing techniques such as edge detection and skew correction
Optimized the evaluation pipeline into an improved document verification workflow
results: Improved document verification throughput by 85% (framing variants: cut verification time by 85%)
example_bullets: Improved merchant onboarding by benchmarking an OCR system comparing Google, AWS, Azure, with image preprocessing (edge detection, skew correction) to extract and validate ID and bank documents, cutting verification time by 85%.
harvested_bullets: Engineered an OCR benchmarking framework for merchant onboarding, comparing Google/AWS/Azure and adding edge detection + skew correction to improve ID/bank doc extraction and validation, boosting verification throughput by 85%.

Optimized merchant onboarding by benchmarking OCR systems and deploying a Python image preprocessing pipeline with skew correction for automated ID and bank document validation, reducing manual verification time by 85%.

title: Merchant Pricing Exception Automation Framework
problem: Manual review of merchant gross-margin exception requests under policy-driven margin rules led to slow and inconsistent decision-making.
actions: Designed a data-driven decision framework based on merchant performance metrics
Automated eligibility evaluation logic for special gross-margin rates using SQL
Integrated performance metrics into the pricing review workflow
Developed Excel scorecards visualizing merchant performance scores against proposed gross-margin rates (GMR) for decision support
results: Reduced review turnaround time from 7 days to 1 day
example_bullets: Implemented a Python + SQL evaluation pipeline to standardize merchant pricing exception checks and generated Excel visualizations benchmarking merchant scores versus target GMR thresholds, cutting approval cycles from 7 days to 1 day.

Built SQL-based eligibility logic and Excel scorecards comparing merchant performance metrics against proposed gross-margin rates (GMR), automating exception reviews and reducing decision turnaround from 7 days to 1 day.
harvested_bullets: Automated pricing exception reviews by building a data analysis pipeline with SQL to assess merchant performance metrics, generating Excel scorecards for GMR approvals and reducing decision turnaround from 7 days to 1 day.

Streamlined gross-margin exception reviews by building an automated decision framework in SQL to analyze merchant performance metrics, producing Excel scorecards that reduced approval turnaround from 7 days to 1 day.
